HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 77-year-old male admitted for upper GI bleed. Admission data:

Day 0 orders/meds/results: EGD: bleeding duodenal ulcer, treated with endoscopic clips; Pantoprazole 80 mg IV
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Type 2 diabetes. Acute blood loss anemia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.84-0.87, hemoglobin 11.7-12.5, platelets 240-249, sodium 139, wbc 7.1-7.8; vitals dbp 69-74, heart_rate 70-73, map 87-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 120-124, spo2 97-98, temp 36.8-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Transfuse 1 unit packed red blood cells
Assessment and plan: Upper GI bleed. Type 2 diabetes. Acute blood loss anemia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 77-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Upper GI bleed. Type 2 diabetes. Acute blood loss anemia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
